runs.label: baseline
runs.sql: WITH behavior AS (SELECT l.entity_id customer_id,t.subsidiary_id,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) total_transactions,count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month',t.accounting_period_ending)) active_months,count(DISTINCT quarter(t.accounting_period_ending)) active_quarters,sum(t.converted_amount) total_revenue,avg(t.converted_amount) avg_transaction_value,stddev_samp(t.converted_amount) transaction_value_volatility,max(t.converted_amount) max_transaction_value,min(t.converted_amount) min_transaction_value,min(t.accounting_period_ending) first_transaction_date,max(t.accounting_period_ending) last_transaction_date,date_diff('day',min(t.accounting_period_ending),max(t.accounting_period_ending)) customer_lifespan_days,date_diff('day',max(t.accounting_period_ending),DATE '2025-10-14') days_since_last_transaction,DATE '2025-10-14' analysis_date,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE quarter(t.accounting_period_ending)=1) q1_transactions,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE quarter(t.accounting_period_ending)=2) q2_transactions,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE quarter(t.accounting_period_ending)=3) q3_transactions,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE quarter(t.accounting_period_ending)=4) q4_transactions FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l USING(transaction_line_id) WHERE l.entity_id IS NOT NULL AND t.account_type_name='Income' AND t.converted_amount>0 GROUP BY l.entity_id,t.subsidiary_id), retention AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN customer_lifespan_days>=365 THEN 'Long-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days>=180 THEN 'Medium-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days>=90 THEN 'Short-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days>=30 THEN 'New' ELSE 'Very New' END retention_category,CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=30 THEN 'Highly Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=90 THEN 'Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=180 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=365 THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Lost' END activity_status,total_transactions/nullif(customer_lifespan_days/30.0,0) avg_transactions_per_month,CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=30 AND total_transactions>=5 THEN .95 WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=60 AND total_transactions>=3 THEN .80 WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=90 AND total_transactions>=2 THEN .60 WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=180 THEN .30 WHEN days_since_last_transaction<=365 THEN .10 ELSE .05 END::DECIMAL(3,2) retention_probability FROM behavior), cp AS (SELECT *,percent_rank() OVER(ORDER BY total_revenue) rev_pct FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability), enriched AS (SELECT cp.*,r.*,CASE WHEN cp.rev_pct>=.9 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cp.rev_pct>=.7 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cp.rev_pct>=.5 THEN 'Silver' WHEN cp.rev_pct>=.3 THEN 'Bronze' ELSE 'Basic' END value_tier FROM cp LEFT JOIN retention r ON r.customer_id=cp.customer_id), scored AS (SELECT *,least(100,revenue_score*10+frequency_score*5+margin_score*5+CASE WHEN activity_status='Highly Active' THEN 15 WHEN activity_status='Active' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END+retention_probability*20)::INTEGER comprehensive_customer_score,CASE WHEN customer_age_days<=90 AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active','Active') THEN 'Onboarding' WHEN customer_age_days<=365 AND total_revenue>(SELECT avg(total_revenue) FROM cp) THEN 'Growth' WHEN retention_category IN ('Long-term','Medium-term') AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active','Active') THEN 'Mature' WHEN activity_status='At Risk' THEN 'At Risk' WHEN activity_status IN ('Dormant','Lost') THEN 'Churned' ELSE 'Developing' END lifecycle_stage FROM enriched), insights AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN q1_transactions>=greatest(q2_transactions,q3_transactions,q4_transactions) THEN 'Q1 Peak' WHEN q2_transactions>=greatest(q1_transactions,q3_transactions,q4_transactions) THEN 'Q2 Peak' WHEN q3_transactions>=greatest(q1_transactions,q2_transactions,q4_transactions) THEN 'Q3 Peak' WHEN q4_transactions>=greatest(q1_transactions,q2_transactions,q3_transactions) THEN 'Q4 Peak' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END seasonal_preference,CASE WHEN transaction_value_volatility IS NULL OR transaction_value_volatility=0 THEN 'Single Transaction' WHEN transaction_value_volatility<=.3*avg_transaction_value THEN 'Very Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility<=.6*avg_transaction_value THEN 'Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility<=avg_transaction_value THEN 'Moderate Variance' ELSE 'High Variance' END transaction_consistency,CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage='Onboarding' AND comprehensive_customer_score>=70 THEN 'High Growth Potential' WHEN lifecycle_stage='Growth' AND value_tier IN ('Gold','Platinum') THEN 'Expansion Ready' WHEN lifecycle_stage='Mature' AND activity_status='Highly Active' THEN 'Loyalty Program Candidate' WHEN lifecycle_stage='At Risk' AND value_tier IN ('Silver','Gold','Platinum') THEN 'Recovery Priority' ELSE 'Standard Growth' END growth_potential FROM scored) SELECT customer_id,customer_name,customer_email,subsidiary_id,customer_segment profitability_segment,value_tier,lifecycle_stage,activity_status,retention_category,total_revenue,net_profit,transaction_count,avg_transactions_per_month,comprehensive_customer_score,retention_probability,seasonal_preference,transaction_consistency,growth_potential,CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage='Churned' AND value_tier IN ('Gold','Platinum') THEN 'Win-Back Campaign' WHEN lifecycle_stage='At Risk' THEN 'Retention Campaign' WHEN lifecycle_stage='Onboarding' THEN 'Onboarding Support' WHEN growth_potential='Expansion Ready' THEN 'Upsell Opportunity' WHEN value_tier='Platinum' AND activity_status='Highly Active' THEN 'VIP Treatment' ELSE 'Regular Engagement' END recommended_action,CASE WHEN value_tier='Platinum' THEN 'Weekly' WHEN value_tier='Gold' THEN 'Bi-weekly' WHEN value_tier='Silver' THEN 'Monthly' WHEN lifecycle_stage='At Risk' THEN 'Immediate' ELSE 'Quarterly' END engagement_frequency,customer_age_days,DATE '2025-10-14' segmentation_date,transaction_value_volatility,q1_transactions,q2_transactions,q3_transactions,q4_transactions,md5(customer_id||'_'||cast(DATE '2025-10-14' AS VARCHAR)) customer_analytics_id FROM insights WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND total_revenue>0
